confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels, moved forward to July 2026 for local inflation; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant meal anchors are moderately reliable; draft beer, cocktail, wine and hotel and hostel rates are less certain and vary by venue, location and season. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the draft beer anchor using typical local price ratios because direct recall for them is weaker. Ringgit prices were converted at an assumed mid-2026 planning rate, not a looked-up rate. The FX value came from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages rather than a direct page read, so verify the 2026-10-15 figure on the RBA daily table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Kuala Lumpur-specific recall of restaurant, bar, hostel and hotel price levels, placed within the Southeast Asian large-city price tier.
